fetched_from.read: the jobs of a run at the release commit

recorded.as: exactly what gh printed: the status line, every response header and the body, unedited

served_in_progress.why: The release tail runs as publish's last step, so the step sees its own job still running: the replay serves this one job with status in_progress, conclusion null and completed_at null. This is the one change any served recording carries; the file holds what GitHub answered.
